topics.topic: Security re-review outcomes for categories affected by the changed A17 rollback guarantee
questions: After the new A17 listener-rollback guarantee reopened the categories that reference A17, is the security review still pending, or were authentication_credential_abuse, secrets and concurrency reviewed again with recorded outcomes?

What are the reopened review outcomes for authentication_credential_abuse, secrets and concurrency—the categories that name A17—after A17 added closure of the owner-interface listener and the guarantee that it serves no request when opening the service API listener fails?
What is the security-review outcome for A17's new requirement to close the already-open owner-interface listener when the service API listener cannot be opened?

quotes:
Performed again on 2026-11-24, after that day's changes reopened it (rule 2):
every formal invariant of A01–A18, A21 and A22 was given an identifier and its
Required tests a binding to the check that shows it; the formulas of A01-2,
A05-1, A10-1 and A12-2 were restated as their normative rules already read —
a repeat refused only at stages (1) to (4) of A04 rule 6 or, for a room or a
pointer, on an archived project (A01 rule 3); a same-state transition being
one that passed every check (A05 rules 1 and 4); registration checked for the
token only and the set asked only for an operation on a project (A10 rule 1);
a session's end making no next version (A12 rule 2) — and Required tests
were added to A02, A03, A04, A05, A06, A09, A11, A12, A14 and A17. No
normative rule changed. Reviewed under authorization (A04, A09, A10, A11,
A12), concurrency (A01, A04, A12, A14, A17), injection_interpreted_input
(A02), authentication_credential_abuse (A09, A17) and secrets (A14, A17): the
new tests show refusals and guarantees the rules already gave — an answer
above the token's class refused whole, the owner's CSRF check answering
before a stale revision, a session's end removing every fact of it, a stale
owner end refused, every check made before the listeners stopping the start before any
listener is opened
— and no outcome changed.
judgement.why: The 2026-11-24 passage expressly says the changes reopened A21, records review under concurrency, authentication_credential_abuse and secrets with A17 named, and states that no outcome changed.
options: The review is pending, so “Security review: PERFORMED” must not describe the current changed State 2.
Review the A17 change under authentication_credential_abuse, secrets and concurrency and record that no outcome changes.
Review the affected categories and amend any outcome, references, affected subjects or required guarantees that the listener rollback changes.
consequences: The recorded re-review keeps A21 complete and leaves all three category outcomes unchanged.

topics.topic: Required owner-interface client behavior during startup before service API listener failure
questions: What must an owner-interface caller observe if it connects after that listener opens but before opening the service API listener fails: a failed connection, a connection closed without an HTTP answer, or a connection left unanswered until the caller times out?

What must a client observe if it connects to the owner interface after its listener opens but before the service API listener fails: must the connection receive no HTTP answer, or may Registry return an explicit startup-failure response without performing the requested operation?

quotes:
Until every listener step 4 opens is open — the owner
   interface's alone in an owner-only start — an opened one accepts
   no connection: a connection that arrives meanwhile waits in the
   listener's queue and is accepted now, or is closed unanswered when the
   start fails.
judgement.why: State 4 fixes the listener mechanism and resulting observation: the connection waits unaccepted in the listener queue and, if startup fails, is closed without an answer.
options: The connection attempt fails; no connection is established.
A connection may be established, but Registry closes it without an HTTP answer.
A connection may be established and remain unanswered until the caller times out.
Registry may return an explicit startup-failure response, such as 503, but performs no requested operation.
The owner socket may be bound but must not accept connections until every listener check passes.
consequences: The selected State 4 behavior permits the transport connection to wait in the listener queue, forbids an HTTP startup-failure answer, and closes the connection unanswered when the service API listener fails.
